summary: The composer toolbar takes the builtin `plus`: a "+" button with a menu of `attach`, `trigger:<char>` rows, `composer.items` and an optional `source` section of completion entries (`composer.plusMenu`). Without `plus` in the toolbar nothing changes.
howTo: If you built your own "+" or "more" menu next to the composer (via `renderActions` or `components.InputExtra`), put `'plus'` into `composer.toolbar.start` or `end` and list its rows in `composer.plusMenu.items`: `attach` opens the file picker, `'trigger:@'` opens the `@` list with the focus in the editor (named after the trigger's `label`), keys of `composer.items` run their `onSelect(controls)`. `plusMenu.source: { trigger: '/', source: 'templates', label: 'Templates' }` lists that provider's entries directly; choosing one follows its `select` (`text` inserts `insertText`). The menu texts are the optional locale keys `plusMenuButtonLabel` and `plusMenuAttachLabel` (English and German built in).
